ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to linear abrasions and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black substrate; high-contrast white clusters (geometric blobs) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; sparse, high-contrast white linear filaments distributed across the central and medial lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 135 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the vertical lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary; fine-scale, high-frequency serrations along the medial trailing edges; macro-level pixel-amplitude variations (irregular peaks) localized at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted from the median notch vertex to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the left and right distal tips; secondary clusters visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Complex network of unaligned white linear disruptions; prominent near-vertical linear mark on the interior left lobe; multiple crisscrossing diagonal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring across both lobes; distinctive vertical linear trauma mark on the mid-left lobe; irregular erosion of the trailing edge at the distal tips.
